images.01: Near-future Tashkent street, 2035: a sleek white driverless robotaxi with no steering wheel and a glowing friendly light strip parked at the curb; an Uzbek woman Muqaddas opa, 55, colorful floral headscarf, cardigan, holding big market bags, peering into the empty driver seat suspiciously. Bright sunny day, green trees.
images.02: Inside the driverless robotaxi: Uzbek woman Muqaddas, 55, floral headscarf, sitting in the back seat with market bags, talking and gesturing to a small glowing screen with a cute digital face on the dashboard, no driver, no steering wheel.
images.02_b: SMALL CHANGE: same picture, but the woman now wags her finger at the screen and the screen face shows a confused expression.
images.03: Close-up of the robotaxi dashboard screen showing a cute glowing digital face with polite eyes and a fixed price tag icon, futuristic clean interior, soft blue light.
images.04: Infographic-style illustration: many white driverless robotaxis driving on a big American city street at dusk with glowing sensors on their roofs, calm and futuristic.
images.05: Uzbek woman Muqaddas, 55, floral headscarf, holding up a jar of homemade apricot jam toward the robotaxi screen, smiling cunningly, offering a deal, market bags beside her.
images.06: Robotaxi arriving at a busy Chorsu-like bazaar with a big blue dome market building; the Uzbek woman with floral headscarf getting out happily, her neighbor Dilfuza, 50, waiting with surprised face.
images.07: Two Uzbek women neighbors laughing together at the bazaar entrance, one with floral headscarf telling a story with big gestures, the robotaxi driving away with a tiny jar of jam on its roof.
